name: Ab Wheel Rollout
summary: A demanding rollout that trains the abs to resist extension of the spine. Start with a short range of motion.
setup: Kneel on a mat and hold the ab wheel under your shoulders.
Tuck the pelvis slightly and round the upper back a little.
Brace the abs and squeeze the glutes.
execution: Roll the wheel forward slowly, keeping the hips and ribs in line.
Go only as far as you can keep the lower back from arching.
Pull the wheel back by contracting the abs, not by dropping the hips first.
Return to the start position and repeat.
mistakes: Arching the lower back: shorten the range and keep the pelvis tucked.
Dropping the hips first on the way back: lead with the abs.
Going too far too soon: increase range gradually over weeks.
Using the wheel against a wall for beginners if the movement is too hard.
